Guidance & outlook: As capacity utilization improves and newer businesses gain scale, the company expects operating leverage benefits to support margin expansion and remains confident of progressively movin g towards its EBITDA margin target of 17.5% to 18%.

Despite the prevailing geopolitical uncertainty and the challenges arising from West Asia situation, we remain confident in the underlying demand environment and reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 15%.
The new line is expected to be commissioned by Q4 FY27 and increasing our manufacturing capacity by approximately 30 to 35 percentage.
Growth & demand: Coming to our segment performance, our core Pen segment delivered 9% year -on-year growth with demand remaining positive during the back -to-school season.

The new line is expected to increase our manufacturing capacity by approximately 35%, enabling us to cater the growing demand of domestic and international demand. *Errata: Please note that EBITDA year-over-year growth is 7.7% instead of 23%.
Domestic sales grew 13% Y -o-Y to INR277 crores compared to INR245 crores in Q1 FY26, reflecting continued demand for our brands in the domestic market.
Margins & costs: Gross profit stood at INR158.6 crores, up 10% year-on-year, with gross margin at 50%, broadly in line with historical levels with a modest 31 basis point year-on- year decline, which is driven by geopol itical uncertainties and an elevated cost environment across the industry.
EBITDA stood at INR53.3 crores, growing 7.7% year -on-year, while EBITDA margin stood at 16.7%, a 46 bps decline year-on-year.
EBITDA margin declined to 16.7% from 17.9% in Q4 FY26 and 17.2% in Q1 FY26, while gross margin softened to 49.7% from 51.2% and 50% in corresponding period last year.
Capex & expansion: With the planned capacity expansion in Steel Bottles and continued scaling up of the Creative Product business, we expect the combined contribution to increase to approximately 35% to 38% of overall company revenue in FY27.
During Q1, the company incurred a total capital expenditure of INR43.42 crores, of which INR33.25 crores was capitalized towards the factory building in Valsad facility.

See, currently, so if you look at Stee l Bottles, currently, the capacity utilization is about 65% and going forward, historically also, whenever we cross 65%, 75%, we tend to invest in the new expansion.
Balance sheet & cash: We are a zero debt company and all the internal accruals are for future expansion and for the shareholders.
So I'll share with you Working capital has, in fact, year-on-year, if you see, my working capital has gone down by 6 days, has improved.
So overall, we expect a continued gradual improvement in both inventory and receivable days, which will support a - healthier working capital cycle in FY27.
Risks & challenges: As of today, these statements are not a guarantee of future performance and will involve unforeseen risks and uncertainties.
Exports stood at INR43 crores and remained broadly flat year-on-year, primarily due to disruptions in the West Asia, resulting in longer transit times and higher freight costs during the quarter.

As a result, despite the inflationary environment due to geopolitical uncertainties, the sequential gross margin decline has been limited to 150 bps, which basically demonstrates the effectiveness of these corrective actions which we undertook during the quarter.
